meta.name: RecoveryOS: Precision Statement
meta.description: A calm, precise, clinical-tech recovery room. Deep cool ink, one electric-blue signal, mint-teal for confirmed facts, coral only for real blockers. Reads like a meticulously typeset holding statement on a dark instrument panel. Richness comes from motion and craft, not density.
source_references: Owner redesign brief (2026-09): deep ink/charcoal base, cool teal/electric-blue accent, no warm cream/yellow, premium-minimal, motion-led
Grounded direction #3 (impeccable concept-seed 7658c88c, degraded roll): the depository holding statement (NSDL/CDSL client master list)
No image reference: DNA derived from the written brief (design-dna Phase 2 from description)

primary.role: Signal blue: primary action, active progress, links, focus. The only accent.

secondary.role: Confirmed state only (approved details, completed milestones, active consent).

accent.role: Same as primary; one accent locked for the whole product.

neutral.usage: Lightest to darkest: primary text, secondary text, metadata text, control borders, hairlines, elevated surface, panel, raised surface, page ground. Foreground text uses the light end against the ink ground.

color.contrast_strategy: Light-on-ink. Body 14-16:1, secondary 7.8:1+, metadata 5.2:1+, controls 3:1+. Primary button ink-on-blue 9.1:1.

font_families.heading: Mona Sans Variable (font-stretch 112%)
font_families.mono: Geist Mono Variable (identifiers, checksums, folio and reference numbers only)

typography.font_style_notes: One grotesk family carries everything; hierarchy comes from width (display at 112% stretch), weight and size, never from a second display family. Mono is reserved for real identifiers. Tabular lining numerals for every date, amount and count. No eyebrows, no tracked uppercase labels above headings.

spacing.section_rhythm: Marketing sections breathe at 96-128px desktop / 72px mobile; product screens use 24-40px between blocks. More space above a heading than below it.

layout.grid_system: 12-column CSS grid, asymmetric splits (7/5, 5/7), single column under 768px

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px hairlines (#223038); controls get a 3:1 border (#5E717A)
shape.divider_style: 1px hairline, used between groups, never on every row

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused, offset, tinted to ink
elevation.depth_cues: surface lightness steps + 1px top highlight + translucent sticky chrome

iconography.stroke_weight: regular (1.5px equivalent) for UI, bold for status markers

motion.entrance_pattern: Masked rise: lines settle up out of a clip, like a statement being printed and verified
motion.philosophy: cinematic on the marketing page (one authored focal sequence + scroll-scrubbed route), minimal functional in the product (feedback, state, continuity only)

components.button_style: Primary: solid signal blue, ink label, 8px radius, press scale 0.97. Secondary: 1px control border on transparent. Ghost: text only.
components.input_style: Panel-toned field, 1px control border, 8px radius, label above, error below, focus ring in signal blue
components.card_style: Flat panel #141E23, 12px radius, 1px hairline, top highlight; cards only where hierarchy is real
components.navigation_pattern: Translucent sticky bar (backdrop blur), single line, one CTA
components.list_style: Ledger rows separated by hairlines between groups; identifiers in mono, amounts right-aligned tabular
components.component_notes: Badges are full pills with an icon and a text label (never colour alone). Proof cards read like statement entries: label, value, provenance line, confidence line.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A holding statement on an instrument panel: every value has a source line, every step has an owner

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous macro-whitespace; dense only inside data tables
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Weight sits on headlines and one focal visual; everything else recedes into hairlines
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element (the route field), then progressive reveal
visual_language.contrast_level: high for text, low for structure
visual_language.texture_usage: none; depth from light, not grain

composition.grouping_strategy: negative space and hairlines, cards only for real hierarchy

imagery.illustration_style: generative point field and single route line (WebGL), no illustrations
imagery.graphic_elements: one route line motif, hairline rules

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate press feedback, state morphs with a brief blur-masked crossfade
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: colour/opacity shift only, gated to fine pointers
interaction_feel.loading_style: static skeletons shaped like the final layout, no shimmer

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain what will appear and how to get it there
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: name the problem, say nothing changed, give the recovery

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to static: one rendered frame under reduced motion; SVG route when WebGL is unavailable

background_effects.description: Flat ink ground; no animated gradients or mesh

particle_systems.description: A still field of record points (the registry) in gentle perspective. Points near the route brighten; nothing drifts on its own.

params.movement_pattern: static; camera moves only with scroll and pointer
params.color_behavior: slate at low alpha, signal blue within the route's reach
params.spawn_area: jittered grid on a curved sheet

3d_elements.description: The route: a curve through the record field that draws itself from the client's holding to credit, scrubbed by scroll.

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer, alpha, antialias off on DPR>1, DPR capped at 1.75
params.camera: PerspectiveCamera fov 35, slight tilt, critically damped pointer parallax
params.interaction_model: render on demand: frames only while scroll, pointer or tween values are changing

shader_effects.description: Point shader: size attenuation, distance-to-route highlight, draw-progress mask on route points

params.vertex_manipulation: none beyond projection and size attenuation
params.fragment_output: round point with 1px smooth edge, alpha by highlight

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: scrubbed for the route and the pinned sequence; triggered once for the ledger

text_effects.description: Hero headline lines rise out of a mask once, in step with the route drawing

params.border_treatment: 1px hairline bottom, appears only once content scrolls under

svg_animations.description: The route motif drawn by scroll through the three-stage sequence; also the WebGL fallback

visual_effects.composite_notes: One authored moment: the route draws through the record field while the headline settles, then scroll carries the same route through the three stages. Everything else is quiet. Product screens (Operate) get no scroll reveals: only press feedback, state morphs, and the milestone marker arriving on the rail.
